等到建成之后，这个地方也将会成为某些事务的轴心，那些能驱使整个星河旋转的静默外交与软实力博弈将会紧紧围绕着它。
texts.en:
The most crucial feature of the initial stage of the Interstellar Assembly is the Locus. A sophisticated holographic projection of a black hole, it is meant to evoke the gravitational chasm that lurks in the galactic core: the fulcrum upon which the galaxy turns.

Once fully built, this place will also be an axle of sorts, around which the quiet diplomacy and soft power that often drive the galaxy swirl.

label.en: After the next upgrade: Consul Ring built

notes.zh: 审阅说明：星际集会每完成一个建造阶段，由 on_megastructure_built / on_megastructure_upgraded 在建造国触发对应事件（并非选项链接）；各阶段按建造顺序排列。
notes.en: Review note: each build stage of the Interstellar Assembly fires its own event for the builder from on_megastructure_built / on_megastructure_upgraded (not option links); stages are shown in construction order.

texts.zh: 星际集会的第二阶段，领事环，现已建成。这个内环将能够容下我们大部分的外交人员在里面活动。
texts.en: The second stage of the Interstellar Assembly, the Consul Ring, is now complete. This inner circle will house most of our diplomatic staff going forward.

label.en: After the next upgrade: Forum Modules built

title.zh: 星际集会：会议广场模块

texts.zh: 星际集会的外环将会配有大量最先进的隐私保护会议室（当然，只有[Root.GetAdj]能够进行监控）。这座空间站正在迅速成为非现场谈判方面无可辩驳的星系枢纽。
texts.en: The Interstellar Assembly's outer ring is populated with vast, state-of-the-art conference rooms equipped with privacy filters (penetrable only by [Root.GetAdj] surveillance, of course). The station is quickly becoming the de-facto galactic hub for off-site negotiations.

label.en: After the next upgrade: Assembly completed

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的帝国的名称。
note.en: In the game, your empire's name appears here.

texts.zh:
星际集会已全力运作，目前正在招待星际间几股大势力的重要人物们，无论他们是政界还是商界的。

我们的外交官们在跟进空间站内传出的那些国家利益与政治羞辱的信息流时受了不少累。不过至少我们的客人对我们的监控并不关心，只要我们一直为他们提供这种同竞争对手角力的理想环境就好了。
texts.en:
The Interstellar Assembly is now fully operational, and plays host to a number of embassies from the galaxy's major powers, be they political or corporate.

Our diplomats are having a hard time keeping up with the steady flow of information on national interests and political embarrassments we are extracting from the station. At least our guests seem largely disinterested in our surveillance, as long as we provide the ideal environs for them to strong-arm their competitors.

texts.zh: 我们在[interstellar_assembly_system.GetName]发现了一座巨大的被毁空间站。从大量办公空间以及一座配有各种不同类型生命维持设施的论坛看来，我们的科学家认为这是一座“星际集会”的残骸。
texts.en: The remains of a vast space station have been found in [interstellar_assembly_system.GetName]. Judging by the amount of what seems to be office-space and a vast forum outfitted with dozens of different types of life-support systems, our scientists suspect that this is all that remains of an "Interstellar Assembly".

texts.zh: 我们在[interstellar_assembly_system.GetName]发现了一座“星际集会”的残骸，并辨别出了十几种不同物种的干尸。
texts.en: The remains of an "Interstellar Assembly" have been found in [interstellar_assembly_system.GetName]. The mummified remains of at least a dozen different species have been identified so far.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the system's name appears here.

notes.zh: 审阅说明：废墟是地图上预置的，不属于任何建造阶段；首次进入该星系时由 on_entering_system_first_time 触发。
notes.en: Review note: the ruin is a pre-placed map object, not a build stage; on_entering_system_first_time fires this event the first time a ship enters the system.

texts.zh: 位于[From.GetName]的星际集会已经再次上线了。它已准备好再次迎接星系中的外交官们，共同商讨当前太阳周期中的问题。
texts.en: The Interstellar Assembly in [From.GetName] is online again. Once more it is ready for the diplomats of the galaxy to gather in one place to debate the great issues of the current solar cycle.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个地点的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this location appears here.

summary.text:
# 星际集会 / Interstellar Assembly

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/megastructure_events_1.txt、common/megastructures/09_interstellar_assembly.txt、common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt（on_megastructure_built / on_megastructure_upgraded / on_entering_system_first_time）· DLC：Megacorp（按本地化文件名）· 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

在你自己的边境内放置并开工星际集会（见 common/megastructures/09_interstellar_assembly.txt）。每个建造阶段完工时，巨型结构的 on_build_complete 或 on_megastructure_upgraded 触发对应的国家事件；这些事件只是阶段提示，没有选择分支（每个只有一个“确认”选项）。
You place and start a Interstellar Assembly inside your borders (common/megastructures/09_interstellar_assembly.txt). Every completed build stage fires a country event for the builder; these are stage notices with a single confirm option, no branching.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. mega.9006：核心建成 / Locus built
2. mega.9007：执政官环建成 / Consul Ring built
3. mega.9008：论坛模块建成 / Forum Modules built
4. mega.9009：星际集会完工 / Assembly completed

按顺序出现，由建造进度决定，不由事件编号决定。 They appear in construction order, driven by build progress rather than by event id.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 其他帝国的通知 Notices to other empires：
- 无（该巨型结构不向其他帝国发送专门通知）/ none (this megastructure sends no dedicated notices to other empires)
- 废墟 The ruin：mega.9130（星系首次进入时，需该星系的星标记“ruined_interstellar_assembly_system”）可以选择“与我们的相近”（已拥有同类）或“很迷人”（没有同类时，30天后进入通用跟进事件 story.5）；mega.9131 在修复完成后出现。
  mega.9130 fires when a ship first enters the system; the option depends on whether you already own this megastructure ("fascinating" otherwise, which fires the generic follow-up story.5 after 30 days). mega.9131 fires when the ruin is restored.
- 没有随机或互斥分支，只有“建造阶段”与“废墟/修复”两条独立线索。 No random or exclusive branches: two independent threads (build stages; ruin and restoration).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 建造阶段事件仅发给建造国；通知事件发给满足通讯与情报条件的其他非AI国家。 Stage events go to the builder only; notices go to other non-AI countries that meet the communication/intel condition.


## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：common/megastructures/09_interstellar_assembly.txt 各阶段 on_build_complete，common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt 的 on_megastructure_* 与 on_entering_system_first_time 列表，events/megastructure_events_1.txt 中各事件的 trigger/option。
- 更正 Corrections：原先每个阶段、通知与废墟事件各自成为一个单页故事；现合并为同一巨型结构的故事，阶段按建造顺序连接。 Previously every stage, notice and ruin event was its own one-card story; they are merged and ordered by construction.
- 不确定 Uncertain：废墟如何被放置（星系初始化器/事件的星标记）未逐一追踪。 How ruins are placed on the map (system initializers / star flags) was not traced one by one.
